theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiNAB_reducedBoundary_basic
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N), ∀ x ∈ reducedBoundary U μ ν, x ∈ U ∧ ‖reducedNormal μ ν x‖ = 1 ∧ Tendsto (normalAverage μ ν x) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (reducedNormal μ ν x)) ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → 0 < μ (Metric.ball x ρ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
